name: The Brocas riverside meadow
summary: Across Windsor Bridge and along the Eton-side riverside meadow, then back the same way. Level ground beside the river; rougher underfoot.
notes: Built from OpenStreetMap and a terrain model on the date shown. Nobody from Driftway has walked it yet, so surfaces are as mapped, not as found.
Riverside meadow: expect it to be wetter and softer after rain than any map can say.
